dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. Land parcels only: the area divided into about ten irregular four-sided lots of different sizes by thin ink lines #23281F (about 1.5 px), like a cadastral plan; the lots are empty, plain pale, no fill, no buildings, no trees, no roads drawn as double lines. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
